_about: Every mod the Argonia profile installs, in load order, grouped: core (script extender, fixes, frameworks, USSEP, the TDM/TrueHUD lock-on), combat (Nexus collection xyf1u3 'Soulsborne Combat' out of the box, one row per mod), traversal (FreeClimb), magic (Magic Expanded), world (Black Marsh & Valenwood, the default world), start (Alternate Start), dev (laid only with --dev, never shipped). Archives are downloaded to ~/.argonia/mods by infra/gpu-box/stack.py, cached in s3://argonia-private-050977237313/mods/, and never committed (decision 0003). sha256 is the archive's: null on a new row until `stack.py fetch --record` fills it; stack.py verify checks it and the installed files' hashes. check: a question to answer before the row is trusted. Row order is load order: stage writes plugins.txt from it; `plugins` lists the result (the Skyrim masters, USSEP, Black Marsh.esm, Alternate Start, then the collection's plugins in its order, Magic.esp, FreeClimb.esp).

plugins.file: Dark Souls Movement and Stamina Regen.esp
